points.text: Agent jobs are gather once, change once, prove once, with session-keyed _logs/sess summaries.
New tools: agent_log helpers, stage_patch / promote_patch, NewWeek log wipe, pack/report turn detail.
Web Phase 4 emits new files one at a time; revisions and Phase 5 tests use one tools/_scratch.py.
Parked mandates: Build harness, Refactorer setup, Build week session guide.

entries.summary: Session-keyed agent logs, staged patches, and a stricter Build job cycle.

points.text: Catalog pack/report/read_summary/list_route runners and bind grep, git porcelain, python -c, and double-quoted PowerShell bodies as failed lookups.
One catalog summary read per runner per slice via read_summary.ps1; route cards from list_route.ps1 instead of load-graph crawls.
Session pack skips empty plan stubs; tool histogram ignores shell title junk.
Baked version.json to 0.4.0 after week-4 series-open was left under design/changelog/archive/0.4/0.4.0.md.
Pages skips a full Godot export when game paths are unchanged and reuses a live export cache.
In-game notes on web read window.__wdbNotes from /data/notes.js; service worker cache follows the PCK hash, not the version label.

entries.summary: Offload intercepts plus Pages notes-only deploys so web players can get change notes without re-downloading the whole game cache.

points.text: Opened development week 4 on the live path
Placeholdia guild roofs are russet shingles; storefronts have a short striped cloth awning; the vendor stall uses a canvas tarp
Enter dungeon shows “Consciousness slips the body…” immediately, then the floor loads under that overlay
Dungeon floors paint nearby space first; distant props, extra crystals, ambushes, and the Floor Guardian stream in as you explore
The large dungeon map builds when you open it, not while the floor is loading

entries.summary: Week 4 Grok Build snapshot. Placeholdia roofs and stall cloth are in, and entering a floor covers immediately while nearby dungeon space loads first.
